Soil nail: passive – not prestressed; the force develops with small ground movements and is transferred by friction along its whole length. Dense grid (0,5–1,5 m), shorter (0,6–1,2 H), lower resistance.

Ground anchor: prestressed (to 80–90% of the design force); no force transfer along the free length, only along the fixed length beyond the slip surface. Sparser, longer (≤ 25–30 m), resistance at least an order of magnitude greater.

In which soil can soil nailing NOT be used?
It cannot be used in soft, plastic clay, organic soil, rubble fill or bouldery soil.
